camel_example: aliyun iot QueryDeviceInfo --region cn-hangzhou --IotId Q7uOhVRdZRRlDnTLv000000100 --IotInstanceId 'iot-v64000' --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000 --DeviceName light
description_en: Queries the basic information about a specified device, including the device ID, device certificate, and nickname
description_zh: 查询指定设备的基本信息（设备ID、设备证书和备注名称）
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-device-info --iot-instance-id iot-v64000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name light --iot-id Q7uOhVRdZRRlDnTLv000000100 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryDeviceInfo

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If <props="intl"><ph>the Overview page or </ph></props>this parameter is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.

<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要查询设备所属产品的ProductKey。

<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name of the device that you want to query.

<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要查询设备的设备名称。

<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The device ID of the device that you want to query.


<notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. IotId is a globally unique identifier (GUID) of the device, which corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要查询设备的设备ID。


<notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id
